checks.claim: For in-scope real-estate credit, FEIN and FiAE must be delivered at least ten natural days before contract signing
The FEIN is binding for the lender for the agreed period and at least ten days before signing
The borrower must receive notarial transparency advice and the prior notarial act is a prerequisite to authorising the mortgage deed when the law applies
The borrower must appear before the chosen notary no later than the day before authorisation of the public deed for the prior act
Spanish law provides a statutory process for subrogation and modification of mortgage loans, including binding-offer and debt-certification steps
Mortgage valuation is a distinct regulated input whose purpose includes estimating the value of property offered as mortgage collateral

limitations: This validates suitability as a maintained mortgage-advisory decision-support source, not every sentence exhaustively.
Bank pricing, approval criteria, affordability policies, appraisal validity, product conditions and market rates must be rechecked live for each case.
Signing, notarial acts, regulated intermediation and binding financial execution remain subject to legal/human gates where applicable.
